en: This postcard features a detailed, colored illustration of a large brewery complex with multiple buildings, smokestacks emitting smoke, and surrounding greenery. There is a river or canal running alongside part of the facility with boats visible. In the background, a hilly or mountainous landscape and portions of a city can be seen. At the bottom, there is printed German text in red. The overall style and printing technique suggest an early 20th century period artwork.
